result.instructions: Tools for SpedirePRO, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my shipments are still in transit, and which were delivered this week?"; "What does it cost to send a 2 kg parcel from Rome to Milan? Compare the couriers."; "Find the InPost lockers near postcode 20121 in Milan.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SpedirePRO data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spedire_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spedire_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spedire_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. spedire_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spedire_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Return the SpedirePRO account name, email, wallet credit (credits_amount) and creation date. Also confirms the API key works. GET /v1/me.

tools.name: spedire_get_wallet_movements
tools.title: Wallet movements
tools.description: List wallet credit movements (top-ups, shipment charges, refunds), newest first. GET /v1/wallet.

causal.description: Filter by movement cause code, as the vendor defines it.

tools.name: spedire_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments with status, tracker, sender, receiver, courier and price. Filter by any reference, status or archived flag. GET /v1/shipments-list.

global_return_search.description: Search across reference, merchant_reference and order_reference at once.

status.description: Status code: N validating, O label in progress, B created, E address error, S in transit, D delivered, R refunded, Y out for delivery, T departed, X problem in progress, L delayed, P at pickup point, K returned to sender, G in processing.

tools.name: spedire_get_shipment
tools.title: Get a shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment by reference, tracker, order_reference or merchant_reference (give one). Returns status, exception_code, sender, receiver, courier and price. POST /v1/shipment (read only).

tools.name: spedire_get_shipment_events
tools.title: Shipment events
tools.description: List the webhook event history of one shipment (status changes sent to your webhook). Give reference or tracker. POST /v1/shipment/webhooks (read only).

tools.name: spedire_get_label_url
tools.title: Get label download URL
tools.description: Return a download URL (url, expire) for the shipping label PDF of a shipment. Creates no new label. POST /v1/get-label (read only).

tools.name: spedire_get_quotes
tools.title: Get shipping quotes
tools.description: Return courier rates for a route and parcels (from, to, packages, optional insurance protection_amount). Creates no shipment. POST /v1/get-quotes.

slug.description: Package preset reference from the vendor docs, optional.

tools.name: spedire_list_couriers
tools.title: List couriers
tools.description: List the couriers enabled for the account, with their alias (the value for create_shipment courier), service info, mockable and pickup_type. GET /v1/couriers.

direction.description: Shipment type: N national, X national to SCS, E EU export, F non-EU export, I EU import, T non-EU import, Y SCS import from EU, Z SCS import from non-EU, W abroad to abroad.

main_courier.description: Main courier name, e.g. ups, inpost, sda (case-insensitive).

tools.name: spedire_lookup_postcode
tools.title: Resolve postcode
tools.description: Look up a postcode in a country to check address data before creating a shipment. GET /v1/geo/{country}/{postcode}.

tools.name: spedire_find_drop_off_points
tools.title: Find drop-off points
tools.description: Search lockers and post offices near a city or postcode. direction sender = pickup side (ritiro), receiver = delivery side (consegna). Points come back in the raw format that create_shipment expects. POST /v1/drop-off-points (read only).

vendors.description: Carrier vendors to include, e.g. ups, poste, inpost, mondial_relay.

sender_country.description: Sender country when it differs from country.

tools.name: spedire_get_drop_off_point
tools.title: Get a drop-off point
tools.description: Return one drop-off point by vendor and point_id (from spedire_find_drop_off_points). POST /v1/drop-off-by-id (read only).

tools.name: spedire_create_shipment
tools.title: Create a shipment
tools.description: Create a shipment and its label with a courier. This is a real booking: it charges the account wallet credit (amount in the reply) and cannot be undone by this tool. Get the courier alias from spedire_list_couriers and rates from spedire_get_quotes first. Pass drop-off points exactly as spedire_find_drop_off_points returned them. POST /v1/create-label.

merchant_reference.description: Your own reference, saved on the shipment.

slug.description: Package preset reference from the vendor docs, optional.

courier.description: Courier alias from spedire_list_couriers. Omit to let SpedirePRO choose.

courier_fallback.description: If true, pick the cheapest available courier when the chosen one is not available for this route.

book_pickup.description: Also book a courier pickup where the courier supports it.

value.description: Add-on value. For cod and faster_cod: the amount to collect. For ass: the goods value to insure.

content.description: Parcel contents description and declared amount, optional.

services.description: Drop-off points to use, passed through unchanged from spedire_find_drop_off_points.

tools.name: spedire_correct_address
tools.title: Correct shipment addresses
tools.description: Correct the sender and receiver addresses of a shipment, for example one with address error status E. Send both full addresses. POST /v1/shipment/patch.

tools.name: spedire_book_pickup
tools.title: Book a courier pickup
tools.description: Book a courier pickup on one date for a list of shipment references. The courier collects the parcels at the sender address. POST /v1/book-pickup.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with SpedirePRO
prompts.description: What you can do with SpedirePRO here, with example requests to try.
